login.title: Sign in to STOA
login.subtitle: Continue learning, review family progress, answer teacher requests, or manage STOA.
login.visualTitle: Return to the work already in motion.
login.signingInStatus: Signing you in and preparing your learning space...
login.verifyFirst: Verify your email before signing in
login.forgotPassword: Forgot your password? Your STOA administrator can reset it.

register.title: Choose your STOA account type.
register.subtitle: We’ll tailor the learning experience for students, parents, and teachers.
register.chooseRole: Which account type do you need?
register.studentHelp: Ask questions, receive clear explanations, and continue learning with support.
register.parentHelp: Follow your child’s learning progress and understand where support is needed.
register.tutorHelp: Support students with clear explanations when professional guidance is needed.
register.name: Name
register.acceptTerms: I accept the privacy policy and terms.
register.studentTitle: Tell us where you need support.
register.tutorTitle: Tell us how you support students.
register.answerLanguageHelp: Used for Learning Assistant explanations, separate from the interface language.
register.pendingReview: Your teacher profile has been submitted for review.
register.pendingReviewTitle: Your application is waiting for review.
register.pendingReviewBody: Thanks for applying to teach on STOA. We will review your credentials, contact you for a short interview, and activate your teacher workspace only after approval.
register.reviewStepBody: We check your subjects, experience, and uploaded credentials.
register.interviewStepBody: Our team schedules a short conversation about teaching style and availability.
register.approvalStepBody: Approved teachers receive access to the teacher dashboard and student requests.
register.applicationFailed: We could not submit this teacher application. Please try again.
register.teacherAccountHelp: You will choose a password after your application is approved, using the invitation email.
register.confirmEmailOwnership: I can receive email at this address. The invitation will be sent here.
register.studentDone: Your learning space is ready. Ask your first learning question below.
register.parentRequiredHint: Students under 18 need a parent or guardian contact.
register.parentOptionalHint: You are 18 or older, so parent contact details are optional.

role.title: Choose your STOA account type.
role.subtitle: We’ll tailor the learning experience for students, parents, and teachers.

account.title: Set up your account details.
account.subtitle: Your name, email and password are used to sign in and to confirm your account.

student.title: Tell us where you need support.
student.subtitle: Your age, school and subjects help us adapt explanations to your level.

parent.title: Tell us about your child.
parent.subtitle: These details link your account to your child’s learning space.

teacher.title: Tell us how you support students.
teacher.subtitle: Your subjects, background and introduction go to our review team.

done.title: Almost there.
done.subtitle: Follow the last step below to activate your account.

closed.title: Accounts are issued by STOA
closed.body: STOA is no longer open for public sign-up. Student, parent and administrator accounts are created by a STOA administrator, who passes you your sign-in details.
closed.studentParent: Students and parents: ask your school or the STOA team to open an account for you.
closed.teacher: Teachers: apply through the teacher application. Once it is reviewed we send you an activation link.
closed.contact: Questions about an account? Write to

activate.title: Activate your teacher account
activate.body: This invitation creates your teacher account. Choose a password of at least 12 characters, then sign in.
activate.success: Your teacher account is active. Sign in to open the teacher workspace.
activate.signedInHelp: You are already signed in. Finish activation with this invitation.
activate.missingToken: This invitation link is missing a token. Open the link from your email.
activate.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
activate.failed: We could not activate this invitation. Please try again.

errors.invitation_expired: This invitation has expired. Ask the reviewer to send a new one.
errors.invitation_already_used: This invitation has already been used.
errors.invitation_email_mismatch: This invitation belongs to a different email address.
errors.account_exists: An account already exists for this email. Sign in instead.
errors.password_rejected: This password was rejected. Choose a stronger password.
errors.activation_temporarily_unavailable: Activation is temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.activation_resume_required: Your account was created. Sign in to finish activation.
errors.verified_email_required: Verify your email before finishing activation.

changePassword.title: Change your password
changePassword.body: Enter your current password. We then email a six-digit code to the address on your account.
changePassword.forcedTitle: Choose a new password to continue
changePassword.forcedBody: An administrator reset your password. The temporary password you were given is your current password here. Until you set your own, this is the only page you can use.
changePassword.sentBody: A six-digit code is on its way to {{email}}. It is valid for 10 minutes and can be used once.
changePassword.codeHelp: Use the six-digit code from the STOA email. It expires after 10 minutes.
changePassword.successBody: Your password has been changed. You are still signed in and can carry on.
changePassword.passwordMismatch: The two passwords do not match.
changePassword.failed: We could not change this password right now. Please try again.

errors.password_change_verification_failed: This code cannot be used. Request a new code and try again.
errors.password_change_credentials_invalid: That current password is not right. Check it and try again.
errors.password_change_code_rate_limited: Too many codes requested. Wait a while before asking for another.
errors.password_change_code_delivery_failed: The code could not be sent. Your current password still works; try again in a few minutes.
errors.password_requirements_not_met: This password was rejected. Choose a password that meets the listed requirements.
errors.auth_request_rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errors.identity_provider_unavailable: Changing a password is temporarily unavailable. Try again in a few minutes.

verification.title: Verify your email
verification.registerBody: We created your account, but you are not signed in yet. Enter the code sent to {{email}} to activate access.
verification.loginBody: Email verification is required before sign-in. Enter the code sent to {{email}} or request a new one.
verification.codeHelp: Use the code from your STOA verification email.
verification.confirmedBody: Your email is verified. Sign in to continue.
verification.alreadyVerifiedBody: This email is already verified. Sign in to continue.
verification.alreadyRequestedBody: A verification code was already requested recently. Check your inbox before trying again.
verification.sentBody: A new verification code has been sent. Check your inbox.
verification.acceptedBody: If an account needs verification, a code will be sent.
verification.expired: This verification code has expired. Send a new code and try again.
verification.invalid: The verification code is invalid. Check the code and try again.
verification.unauthorized: We could not use this sign-in session for email verification. Send a new code and try again.
verification.rateLimited: Too many verification attempts. Wait a moment before trying again.
verification.failed: We could not verify this email right now. Please try again.
